page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance utilizes KVM virtualization to deliver dedicated compute resources. The memory configuration provides a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, positioning it for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute cores.

The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating efficient data transfer across cloud environments. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage options. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r9ae.16xlarge offers a high-density memory profile without the overhead of local storage or specialized GPU hardware. This makes it a resource-efficient choice for workloads that scale horizontally or rely heavily on network-attached storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance, avoiding the resource contention typical of shared-core environments.
This server is suited for memory-intensive applications, including large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, big data analytics, and high-performance caching layers.
